ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; dominant low-intensity (black) pixels across ~80% of the surface area with high-intensity (white) linear and circular clusters covering ~20%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast linear white markings distributed horizontally and diagonally across the mid-sections of both lobes; dense circular white clusters concentrated at the distal tips; sparse white mottling localized to the right lobe's inner trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged, irregular peaks and valleys visible along the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe trailing edge is obscured by high-intensity water spray and foam.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity circular pixel clusters at both terminal fluke tips; scattered white focal spots across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive parallel and intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the central-medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional rake marks and heavy barnacle colonization on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique geometric lattice-like intersection of parallel white abrasions on the left lobe's upper quadrant.
